description: Sidebar component for navigation and content organization in a React application, featuring responsive design and controlled/uncontrolled open/close state management.

methods.name: normalizePx
methods.description: Normalizes the value to a pixel string, providing a fallback if the value is null.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Handles the toggling of the sidebar state, either through a controlled onToggle prop or internal state.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on menu items, triggering onSelect and onClick callbacks.

methods.name: handleBackdrop
methods.description: Closes the sidebar when clicking on the backdrop.
